Name: EoW - White Junimo Hut
Author: EmissaryOfWind
Description:
A white Junimo hut to match EemieStardew's [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/419/?]Medieval Modern buildings[/url].

Installing:
Unpack the file to your Stardew Valley\Content folder. I recommend making a backup of this folder before installing.

To uninstall, you can then simply copy your backed up Junimo Hut.xnb to your Content\Buildings folder.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
